authority: definition and request-contract artifact only; not source-access authorization, entitlement proof, provider access, archive inspection authority, factual gate validation, or strict readiness authority

lineage.supersession_reason: add authorized market-calendar source-of-record, conditional timing-artifact dependency, executable eligible-trading-session mapping, replayable session schema, and source-capability attestation

purpose: Lock strict Gate A first-public/unrestated EPS selection, timing capability, calendar provenance, and replayable daily decision-session mapping before any export or local-byte inspection.

eps_basis.field_mnemonics: must be confirmed from the licensed data dictionary; no mnemonic is assumed in this request

event_basis.fallback: none; absence of an eligible first-public release is a fail-closed missing result
event_basis.original_10Q_role: corroboration only unless a later separately approved contract changes the event basis

fiscal_period_identity.currency_rule: currency must be explicit and consistent within each selected issuer-quarter record; unresolved currency differences fail closed
fiscal_period_identity.share_adjustment_rule: the selected record must carry sufficient source metadata to identify the reported per-share basis and any source adjustment treatment; undocumented retrospective adjustment fails closed

source_roles.role: primary candidate layer for the first-public earnings-release event
source_roles.rule: may supply the selected value only if all event, status, timing, calendar, and source-dictionary requirements are met
may not silently replace the primary selected first-public value

source_roles.role: revision, effective, thru, and delivery lineage verification
source_roles.rule: may not silently replace the primary selected first-public value
is not an automatic fallback for a missing first-public earnings release

selection_rule.tie_break: exact duplicate records with identical issuer-quarter, value, currency, status, and timestamp lineage may be deduplicated deterministically by source record identity; conflicting duplicate candidates fail closed
selection_rule.later_restatement_rule: later restated or amended records must be retained only as exclusion/lineage evidence and must never replace the selected first-public value

coverage_rule.denominator: every issuer-quarter in the approved M6b Gate A universe after deterministic fiscal-period and identifier eligibility rules
coverage_rule.numerator: denominator records with one uniquely selected eligible first-public non-restated EPS record and complete timing, calendar, and source lineage
coverage_rule.missingness: every denominator record absent from the numerator requires a stable fail-closed missing reason

source_capability_attestation.insufficient_pit_timing_rule: if the selected PIT-family record lacks a complete eligible release timestamp with unambiguous timezone semantics, the approval response must name a separately authorized immutable linkable timing artifact; otherwise Gate A remains blocked

timing_artifact_contract.timing_artifact_required_rule: true iff the selected EPS source record lacks a complete eligible release timestamp with unambiguous timezone semantics

when_required.failure_rule: zero-match, many-match, ambiguous, unmatched selected source record, or timing coverage gap fails closed

calendar_source_of_record.eligible_trading_session_definition: calendar date where is_trading_session is true and scheduled_close_local is non-null; includes normal and officially early-close dates
calendar_source_of_record.reviewer_c_rule: Reviewer C must reproduce every session mapping from the exact calendar artifact and SHA-256

daily_decision_session_rule.definition: decision_session is the first eligible_trading_session date strictly later than release_local_exchange_date

consistency_rules: is_trading_session=true requires scheduled_close_local non-null and the timestamp includes release_local_exchange_date and calendar_exchange_timezone or an explicit offset
is_trading_session=false requires event_date_session_classification in {holiday, weekend, non_session} and scheduled_close_local=null
is_trading_session=null requires event_date_session_classification=unclassifiable, scheduled_close_local=null, decision_session=null, and stable_fail_closed_missing_reason non-null
normal_session or early_close_session requires release_close_classification in {before_close, at_close, after_close}
holiday, weekend, or non_session requires release_close_classification=non_session
timing_artifact_required=false requires timing_artifact_path=null, timing_artifact_sha256=null, timing_join_key=null, and timing_join_cardinality=not_required
timing_artifact_required=true requires non-null timing_artifact_path, timing_artifact_sha256, timing_join_key, and timing_join_cardinality=one_to_one
missing, ambiguous, or non-convertible timestamp timezone requires decision_session=null and stable_fail_closed_missing_reason non-null
session_mapping_record_schema.replay_rule: Reviewer C must reproduce every session-mapping field solely from authorized raw bytes, the locked contract, and the exact calendar artifact; hidden notebooks, package defaults, generic weekday logic, and external calendar services are prohibited

required_references_after_approval: staging-only strict Gate A provenance input
Reviewer C raw-byte and calendar replay packet
approval_effect: only enables a separate source-access authorization request; it does not itself authorize export, archive inspection, provider access, factual validation, or readiness promotion
